findings.reason: The cited evidence shows the alarm and traffic anomalies but does not explicitly state the cause is reduced modulation or capacity reduction.
The topology outputs for all three sites explicitly list LNK-TUN-02-C and AGG-TUN-02 in their dependency chains.
The alarm record explicitly states the major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on LNK-TUN-02-C was raised at 18:47 and cleared at 23:54.
The alert record explicitly states traffic drops and latency spikes on the three sites between 18:45 and 23:45.
The maintenance check output explicitly reports no scheduled maintenance windows for the listed nodes and parents in the specified time window.
The runbook describes the signature of microwave link degradation involving reduced modulation, matching the observed alarm and traffic patterns.
